title: Retroperitoneal leiomyosarcoma
extract_protocol_ch1: At the time of tumor resection, a sample of the resected tumor was collected. The specimen was transported on ice in Miltenyi MACS tissue storage solution to Retro Bio.
Library preparation was performed by Retro Bio using 10x Genomics Single Cell 5' PE chemistry.

title: SJRHB010928_C1_DYE0282
extract_protocol_ch1: Extract protocol: To dissociate organoids into single-cell suspension 40U papain was added to 400uL of papain buffer(1mM L-cystein, 0.5mM EDTA in PBS -/-) and incubated at 37°C for ~5 min. The organoids were added and incubating at 37°C for ~5 min with occasional flicking until the organoid dissociated to the point of floating. 40uL of DNase was added and the dissociated cells were incubated at 37 °C for an additional 5 min. The cell suspension was filtered with a 40-μm mesh cell strainer and washed with 2mL PBS−/−. The filtered cells were slowly added to a 5 ml BSA cushion medium (4% BSA in Retinal Explant media) and spun at 500g for 10 min at 4 °C to separate the cells from the debris. The supernatant was removed and resuspend the cell pellet in 400 μl of explant culture medium. To generate single-nucleus suspensions from flash-frozen tissue frozen fragments were manually dissociated using Noyes spring scissors in 1 mL TST buffer (73 mM sodium chloride, 5 mM Tris [pH 8.0], 0.5 mM calcium chloride, 10.5 mM magnesium chloride, 0.01% bovine serum albumin, 0.03% Tween-20). Nuclear suspensions were filtered through a 40 μm strainer and diluted with an additional 1 mL TST buffer and 3 mL ST buffer (73 mM sodium chloride, 5 mM Tris [pH 8.0], 0.5 mM calcium chloride, 10.5 mM magnesium chloride) and centrifuged at 500xg at 4°C for 5 min. The nuclear pellet was resuspended in ST buffer and filtered through a 40 μm strainer to generate single-nuclear suspensions for snRNA-seq. To generate single-cell suspensions from fresh tissue, samples were rinsed with PBS -/-, minced with a scalpel, and processed using the Papain Dissociation System (Worthington). The tumors were incubated in 5 mL papain-DNase I solution at 37°C for 15-30 min, filtered through a 40 μm strainer, and centrifuged at 500 x g for 5 min. The cell pellets were then resuspended in 3.1 mL resuspension buffer (2.7 mL Earle’s buffered saline solution, 300 μL albumin-ovomucoid inhibitor, 150 μL DNase I) and layered over 5 mL albumin-ovomucoid inhibitor cushion and centrifuged at 100xg for 6 min. The pellet was resuspended in PBS and filtered through a 40 μm strainer.
Single cell RNA sequencing and library preparation was preformed using the 10X genomics 3’ gene expression kits.

extract_protocol_ch1: Single-nuclei suspension from frozen sarcoma metastases were generated using methods published in Slyper et al. (Nature Medicine, 2020) with modifications. The tissue was first cut in 20 µm sections using a cryostat and stored on dry ice until the next step. Then the tissue was put on wet ice and washed once with 5 ml PBS to remove OCT. After this step nuclei were extracted by vigorous pipetting in salt-tris buffer with Tween-20 (TST) followed by a high-volume wash in salt-tris buffer (ST). Nuclei were counted and 15,000 nuclei were separated for droplet-based RNA capture and reverse transcription using 10x Genomics 5' v1.1 or 5' v2.0 reagents and a Chromium controller.

Chromium Single Cell V(D)J Enrichment Kit for human T cells Reagent Kit, v 1.1 or Single Cell Human TCR Amplification Kit were utilized for snTCR library generation (10X genomics) depending on whether 5' V1 or 5' V2 kits were utilized for cDNA library generation, respectively. Final sequencing libraries were prepared using Single Index Kit T Set A or Library construction kit (catalog no. 1000190) and Dual Index Kit TT set A (catalog no. 1000215).

title: Empty_IgG
extract_protocol_ch1: Tumor xenografts were minced and digested with Tumor Dissociation Kit (Miltenyi Biotec). Minced tumors were processed with enzyme mix in serum free RPMI 1640 following m_impTumor_02 program of gentleMACS Dissociator. Then, tissues were incubated for 40 min at 37 °C with continuous rotation. After processed with gentleMACS m_impTumor_03 program 2 times, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) were isolated using magnetic cell separation (MACS) column and separator with CD45 (TIL) MicroBeads, human (Miltenyi Biotec).

After confirming cell viability higher than 75% in quality control using AO/PI cell viability kit, sequencing libraries were constructed with Chromium GEM-X Single Cell 3p RNA library v4 (10x Genomics).
